detail: Amemiya is an R alternative variance-component estimator with no corresponding xtreg option. Stata xtreg, re uses its default estimator or sa for Swamy-Arora; the Stata line does not select Amemiya and numerical parity is not claimed.
detail_zh: Amemiya是R中的替代方差分量估计方法，xtreg没有对应选项。Stata的xtreg, re使用默认方法，或以sa选择Swamy-Arora；所示Stata命令不选择Amemiya，不表示数值对应。
setup: set.seed(106); data <- expand.grid(time = 1:10, id = 1:24); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$z <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$u <- rep(rnorm(24), each = 10); data$y <- 1 + 1.8 * data$x + 0.4 * data$z + data$u + rnorm(nrow(data)); data$binary <- as.integer(runif(nrow(data)) < plogis(0.3 * data$x + data$u)); data$count <- rpois(nrow(data), exp(0.3 + 0.2 * data$x + 0.3 * data$u)); pd <- plm::pdata.frame(data, index = c("id", "time"))
meaning: xtreg: Random effects with amemiya variance components

r: plm::plm(y ~ x + z, data = pd, model = "random", random.method = "nerlove")

stata: xtreg y x z, fe vce(cluster id)
r: { V <- plm::vcovHC(fit, method = "arellano", type = "HC1", cluster = "group"); lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = V) }
task_zh: 按个体聚类的面板稳健标准误
detail: Stata xtreg, fe vce(robust) equals vce(cluster id). plm HC1 uses N/(N-K) with K counting within-model coefficients and coeftest uses residual degrees of freedom; Stata also applies its cluster correction and uses G-1 reference degrees of freedom. These standard errors and p-values are not exact Stata finite-sample parity.
detail_zh: Stata的xtreg, fe vce(robust)等同于vce(cluster id)。plm的HC1采用N/(N-K)，K按组内模型系数计数，coeftest采用残差自由度；Stata还应用聚类修正，并以G-1为检验自由度。因此标准误和p值不构成Stata有限样本精确对应。
setup: set.seed(106); data <- expand.grid(time = 1:10, id = 1:24); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$z <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$u <- rep(rnorm(24), each = 10); data$y <- 1 + 1.8 * data$x + 0.4 * data$z + data$u + rnorm(nrow(data)); data$binary <- as.integer(runif(nrow(data)) < plogis(0.3 * data$x + data$u)); data$count <- rpois(nrow(data), exp(0.3 + 0.2 * data$x + 0.3 * data$u)); pd <- plm::pdata.frame(data, index = c("id", "time")); fit <- plm::plm(y ~ x + z, data = pd, model = "within")
meaning: xtreg: Cluster-robust panel standard errors

stata: xtscc y x z, fe lag(2)
r: { V <- plm::vcovSCC(fit, type = "HC1", maxlag = 2); lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = V) }
detail: Requires the community command xtscc (ssc install xtscc); xtreg has no vce(dkraay) option. Both use a within estimator with lag-2 Driscoll-Kraay covariance; finite-sample scaling and reference degrees of freedom differ.
detail_zh: 需要社区命令xtscc（ssc install xtscc）；xtreg没有vce(dkraay)选项。两者均使用组内估计及滞后2阶的Driscoll-Kraay协方差，但有限样本缩放和检验自由度不同。

r: nlme::lme(y ~ x + z, random = ~ x + z | id, data = data, method = "ML")
task_zh: 随机系数面板模型流程
detail: All three coefficients (intercept, x and z) vary by panel. nlme fits a Gaussian mixed model by ML; xtrc uses Swamy random-coefficient GLS, so the estimators and covariance estimates differ.
detail_zh: 截距、x和z三个系数均随面板变化。nlme用ML拟合高斯混合模型；xtrc采用Swamy随机系数GLS，故估计方法和协方差估计不同。
setup: set.seed(94); data <- expand.grid(time=1:12,id=factor(1:30)); data <- data[order(data$id,data$time),]; data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$z <- rnorm(nrow(data)); b <- matrix(rnorm(90),30,3); i <- as.integer(data$id); data$y <- 1+2*data$x-data$z+b[i,1]+b[i,2]*data$x+b[i,3]*data$z+rnorm(nrow(data),sd=.4)
meaning: xtrc: Random-coefficient panel model workflow

r: { fit <- plm::plm(y ~ x + z, data = pd, model = "pooling"); lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = plm::vcovBK(fit, type = "HC0", cluster = "time")) }
detail: vcovBK(cluster="time") allows contemporaneous cross-panel covariance, as required for PCSE. Balancedness, pairwise missing-data treatment, finite-sample normalization and reference tests can still differ from xtpcse.
detail_zh: vcovBK(cluster="time")允许PCSE所需的同期跨面板相关；面板平衡性、成对缺失处理、有限样本缩放及检验参考分布仍可能与xtpcse不同。

meaning: xtpcse: Beck-Katz panel-corrected covariance

r: survival::survreg(survival::Surv(lower, upper, type = "interval2") ~ x, data = data, dist = "weibull")
detail: Stata requires interval(lower upper). The Weibull time option selects AFT coefficients, matching survreg rather than Stata default PH coefficients. For interval2, equal endpoints are exact events, NA lower endpoints denote left censoring, and NA upper endpoints right censoring; encode Stata left-censoring bounds explicitly.
detail_zh: Stata必须指定interval(lower upper)。Weibull的time选项选择AFT系数，与survreg对应，而非Stata默认的PH系数。interval2中端点相等为精确事件，下端点NA表示左删失，上端点NA表示右删失；须显式转换Stata的左删失边界。
setup: set.seed(107); data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(150), z = rnorm(150), group = rep(0:1, 75), id = rep(1:30, each = 5)); latent <- rexp(150, exp(0.4 * data$x - 0.2 * data$z)); censor <- rexp(150, 0.25); data$time <- pmin(latent, censor); data$event <- as.integer(latent <= censor); data$entry <- 0; data$w <- rep(c(1, 2, 1), 50); data$lower <- pmax(.001, floor(data$time * 2) / 2); data$upper <- ifelse(data$event == 1, data$lower + .5, Inf)
meaning: stintreg: Weibull regression for interval-censored outcomes

detail_zh: 假定Stata的meta声明采用默认random(reml)。model="rma"将效应对标准误回归，并以REML估计加性异质性；model="lm"采用的则是乘性离散。小样本研究效应本身不能证明发表偏差。
meaning: meta: Egger regression asymmetry test

setup: set.seed(118); n <- 300; data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), z = rnorm(n), group = rep(1:30, each = 10)); data$treat <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(.2 + .25 * data$x)); data$y <- 2 * data$treat + .8 * data$x - .3 * data$z + rnorm(n)

stata: drdid y x, ivar(id) time(time) treatment(treated) dripw
r: { ps <- stats::fitted(stats::glm(treated ~ x, data = data, family = stats::binomial())); m0 <- stats::predict(stats::lm(dy ~ x, data = data, subset = treated == 0), data); weighted.mean(data$dy - m0, data$treated) - weighted.mean(data$dy - m0, (1 - data$treated) * ps / (1 - ps)) }
task: Two-period panel doubly robust DiD ATT point estimate
task_zh: 两期面板双重稳健DiD ATT点估计
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Wide-data point-estimation workflow for the dripw variant: logistic propensity plus control-group outcome-change OLS. Stata expects long data. No influence-function variance or improved drimp estimator.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。宽数据的dripw点估计：Logistic倾向模型加对照组结局变化OLS。Stata使用长数据；不含影响函数方差或改进drimp估计量。
setup: set.seed(129); n <- 240; data <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rnorm(n)); data$treated <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(.25 * data$x)); data$y0 <- 1 + data$x + rnorm(n); data$y1 <- data$y0 + .5 + .3 * data$x + 2 * data$treated + rnorm(n, sd = .3); data$dy <- data$y1 - data$y0
meaning: drdid: Two-period panel doubly robust DiD ATT point estimate

task_zh: Sun-Abraham队列交互事件研究估计
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Uses never-treated reference cohorts and -1 event-time reference. Match supported horizons, cohort-share aggregation and covariance conventions to eventstudyinteract.

setup: set.seed(130); data <- expand.grid(time = 1:8, id = 1:90); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; data$cohort <- rep(rep(c(4, 6, 1000), each = 30), each = 8); data$never <- as.integer(data$cohort == 1000); data$treated <- as.integer(data$time >= data$cohort); data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$y <- rep(rnorm(90), each = 8) + .3 * data$time + .4 * data$x + 2 * data$treated + rnorm(nrow(data), sd = .2)
meaning: eventstudyinteract: Sun-Abraham cohort-interacted event-study estimation

stata: did_imputation y id time cohort, allhorizons
r: { untreated <- data$treated == 0; baseline <- stats::lm(y ~ factor(id) + factor(time) + x, data = data, subset = untreated); effects <- data$y - stats::predict(baseline, newdata = data); keep <- data$treated == 1; stats::aggregate(effects[keep], list(horizon = data$time[keep] - data$cohort[keep]), mean) }
task: Untreated-outcome imputation effects by event time
task_zh: 按事件时间汇总未处理结果插补效应

task: Prediction interval for a new study's true effect
task_zh: 新研究真实效应的预测区间
detail: The true-effect prediction interval differs from the pooled-mean confidence interval. Stata uses t(K-2); metafor defaults to a normal quantile. For Stata endpoints compute mu +/- qt(.975,K-2)*sqrt(tau2+se^2); changing metafor test="t" uses K-p degrees of freedom and is not the same correction.
detail_zh: 真实效应预测区间不同于合并均值置信区间。Stata采用t(K-2)，metafor默认使用正态分位数。Stata端点应按mu +/- qt(.975,K-2)*sqrt(tau2+se^2)计算；改用metafor的test="t"会采用K-p自由度，并非相同修正。
meaning: meta: Prediction interval for a new study's true effect

detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Post-imputation derivation is appropriate when the transform is not needed as an imputation predictor; otherwise use passive imputation within the chain.

setup: set.seed(108); data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(80), z = rnorm(80)); data$y <- 1 + 2 * data$x + data$z + rnorm(80); data$x[c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 25, 33, 45)] <- NA_real_; data$z[c(4, 12, 24, 37, 60)] <- NA_real_; imp <- mice::mice(data, m = 3, maxit = 3, method = "pmm", seed = 108, printFlag = FALSE)
check: stopifnot(length(.result) == 3, all(vapply(.result, function(d) max(abs(d$square - d$x^2)) == 0, logical(1))))
meaning: mi: Derive a nonlinear variable consistently in each completed dataset

r: { completed <- mice::complete(imp, "all"); Q <- vapply(completed, function(d) mean(d$x), numeric(1)); U <- vapply(completed, function(d) stats::var(d$x) / nrow(d), numeric(1)); mice::pool.scalar(Q, U, n = nrow(data), k = 1) }

setup: set.seed(108); data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(80), z = rnorm(80)); data$y <- 1 + 2 * data$x + data$z + rnorm(80); data$x[c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 25, 33, 45)] <- NA_real_; data$z[c(4, 12, 24, 37, 60)] <- NA_real_; imp <- mice::mice(data, m = 3, maxit = 3, method = "pmm", seed = 108, printFlag = FALSE)
